node.title: Re^4: Which pragmas are activated with a specific perl version?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Where did you get this version of the table?

I got it from the link I posted ([http://perldoc.perl.org/feature.html#FEATURE-BUNDLES]), which at the moment is the Perl 5.26.1 documentation. The table you showed has the same entries - I assume you have Perl 5.18 installed, which is why your table doesn't go any further.

If you want to stay absolutely up-to-date, see the %feature_bundle hash (and the corresponding table near the bottom of the file) in [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/HEAD:/lib/feature.pm|lib/feature.pm] in the Perl source repository (Update: or [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/HEAD:/regen/feature.pl|regen/feature.pl]). According to that, the features for use 5.028; will be qw/say state switch unicode_strings unicode_eval evalbytes current_sub fc postderef_qq bitwise/ (subject to change, of course).
